'@{pipeline().Pipeline}' as Pipeline_Name,
'@{pipeline().RunId}' as RunId,
'@{concat(pipeline().parameters.folder,item().name)}' as Source,

'@{pipeline().TriggerType}' as TriggerType,
'@{pipeline().TriggerId}' as TriggerId,
'@{pipeline().TriggerName}' as TriggerName,
'@{pipeline().TriggerTime}' as TriggerTime,
'@{activity('loadData').output.rowsCopied}' as rowsCopied,

'@{activity('loadData').output.executionDetails[0].sink.type}' as Sink_Type,
'@{activity('loadData').output.executionDetails[0].status}' as Execution_Status,
'@{activity('loadData').output.executionDetails[0].start}' as CopyActivity_Start_Time,
'@{utcNow()}' as CopyActivity_End_Time,

properties.description: Convert SQL table data into csv

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    s.name AS SchemaName,
    t.name AS TableName
FROM sys.tables t
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
WHERE s.name = 'Person' 
  AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0;
